column4: Someone stepping down from a wooden jetty into a small wooden rowing boat: the hull knocks against a jetty post, the boat rocks, water slaps against its sides, the boards creak under the weight. Close, outdoors on a quiet lake, no music, no voice.

Someone climbing out of a small wooden rowing boat up onto a wooden jetty: the boat lurches and knocks a post, water slaps the hull, a rubber boot lands on the planks. Close, outdoors on a quiet lake, no music, no voice.

A small wooden rowing boat coming alongside a wooden jetty: a soft hollow knock of the hull on a post, then a wet mooring rope thrown round the post and pulled tight. Close, outdoors, no music, no voice.

Water rushing and gurgling steadily along the planked side of a small wooden rowing boat gliding through a calm lake, heard from inside the boat, close to the hull, an even seamless loop, no oars, no music.
An old wooden rowing boat creaking softly as it rocks on the water: a slow groan of the planks and one rattle of an iron rowlock. Close, outdoors, no music.
Water dripping and trickling off a wooden oar blade back into a calm lake, a few heavy drops, close and quiet, outdoors, no music.
